editor.ruleHarmonizeDesc: Normalizes genres using fixed rules — "Bubblegum Pop" becomes "Pop", "Classic Rock" becomes "Rock", etc. Runs as a background process.

editor.manualReviewSkippedInfo: {count} songs skipped — genres stay unchanged for now.

midiImport.title: MIDI/KAR Note Import
midiImport.description: Import notes (pitch + timing) from a .mid/.kar file as the note basis — the song’s music file stays untouched. Syllables can optionally be assigned; notes without a syllable get "~".

Paste lyrics here…

sheetMusic.title: Sheet Music Recognition (AI)
sheetMusic.description: Recognize notes (pitch + timing) from a sheet music image or PDF via AI and import them as the note basis — the song’s music file stays untouched. PDFs are rendered page by page and can be analyzed individually or as a whole. Recognition is AI-assisted and should be reviewed; syllables can optionally be assigned, notes without a syllable get "~".

sheetMusic.mergedHint: The voices of all pages were merged by staff position (staff index) in reading order — tempo and warnings come from the first analyzed page.

sheetMusic.pdfRenderError: The PDF could not be read or rendered — please check that it is a valid PDF file.
sheetMusic.pdfPageCapHint: For analysis quality and request limits, at most 12 pages per PDF are analyzed.
sheetMusic.lowQualityWarning: Low recognition confidence — please review the notes after import.
sheetMusic.noVoices: No notes detected — please check the image quality.

syncBackup.appdataActive: Player data & highscores are automatically stored in the Windows AppData folder and survive updates & reinstalls. The manual backup export below is only needed for switching devices.

syncBackup.exportDesc: Bundles your profiles, highscores, achievements, playlists, custom songs and settings into one portable JSON file — for archiving or moving to another device.
syncBackup.includeMediaDesc: Fully self-contained backup file — but considerably larger.
syncBackup.exportError: The backup could not be created.
syncBackup.restoreDesc: Pick a backup file from the other device, review its contents and merge it into this device. Existing progress is never lost — profiles, songs and the best highscores are merged.
syncBackup.invalidFile: This file is not a valid Karaoke ZERO backup.
syncBackup.restoreSettingsToggle: Also apply settings (theme, language, gameplay options)
syncBackup.reloadHint: Reload the page so the restored songs and media appear.
syncBackup.howPoint1: On the source device: create a backup (with or without song media) and move the file to the target device (USB, cloud folder, messenger — the file only leaves your hands if you send it yourself).
syncBackup.howPoint2: On the target device: choose the backup file here and restore it.
syncBackup.howPoint3: Device-bound settings (microphone devices, companion registration, songs-folder paths) are deliberately NOT transferred — they apply per device.
syncBackup.howPoint4: Highscores merge wisely: per song and player the better run always wins — on both devices.

welcome.title: Welcome! 👋
welcome.body:
This is a live tour: I highlight the important spots and explain them.

Controls: "Next" (or key →), "Back" (←) and "End tour" (Esc). Let's go!

heroButtons.title: Quick start
heroButtons.body: "Start Singing" takes you straight to the library. "Party Mode" opens the 9 party games for groups.

dailyCard.title: Daily challenge
dailyCard.body: 5 slots per day with rotating tasks — the more slots you clear, the bigger your XP bonus. Fresh tasks drop at midnight.

weeklyCard.title: Weekly challenge
weeklyCard.body: The weekly counterpart: 5 slots across the week with bigger XP rewards. Perfect for long-term goals.

modeLauncher.title: Sing: Single, Duel & Duet
modeLauncher.body:
🎤 Single: one player, one mic.
⚔️ Duel: two players on the SAME song — most points wins.
🎭 Duet: two voices on two tracks — the library automatically shows only matching duet songs.

libraryNav.title: The library
libraryNav.body: All your songs live here. Search by title or artist — the fuzzy search even forgives typos.

filters.title: Filters
filters.body: Genre, language, year, decade, duet songs and viral hits — slice the library however you like.

songCard.title: Songs
songCard.body: Clicking a song card opens the start dialog: mode, players, microphones and difficulty.

startModal.title: The start dialog
startModal.body:
Set everything here: mode (single/duel/duet), who sings, which mic everyone gets, and the difficulty.

Then hit "Start" — and off you go!

partyCard.title: Party modes
partyCard.body: 9 games for 2–24 players: Battle Royale, Pass-the-Mic, Medley contest, tournament, missing words, blind karaoke and more — phones can join as mics.

partyModes.title: The mode picker
partyModes.body:
This is where you pick the party mode: Battle Royale (last man standing), Pass-the-Mic, tournament (bracket), medley and more.

Each card shows what to expect — one click opens player selection.

jukeboxCard.title: Jukebox
jukeboxCard.body: Karaoke without competition: build playlists, queue songs, share favourites. The perfect background entertainer.

jukeboxView.title: Inside the jukebox menu
jukeboxView.body: "Browse playlists" gives you direct access to every saved playlist — including the ones you created in the library. One click enqueues the whole playlist.

highscoreCard.title: Highscores
highscoreCard.body: Highscores per song and difficulty — beat your friends (or yourself).

highscoreView.title: The highscore boards
highscoreView.body: Filtered by song and difficulty — with the filter bar on top. The phone icons show companion app usage.

settingsCard.title: Settings
settingsCard.body: Microphones, language, gameplay fine-tuning, appearance and graphics — all the knobs live here.

settingsView.title: The settings tabs
settingsView.body: Pick a section at the top: General (language), Gameplay, Appearance, Graphics & Sound, Microphone, Mobile (phone connection) and more.

finish.title: Done! 🎉
finish.body:
You know the basics now.

Tip: the ? icon at the bottom right brings you back anytime — including individual topic chapters and the editor tour.

editor.title: Editor tour
editor.desc: Notes, lyrics, voices & harmonize — the song toolbox.

welcome.title: The editor ✏️
welcome.body:
This is where songs become playable karaoke tracks: place notes, time lyrics, assign voices.

Sandbox tip: practise on a test song — changes can be undone with Ctrl+Z.

songList.title: Song selection
songList.body: Search a song to open it. Filters reveal songs with missing metadata — the editor harmonizes those later.

noSongs.title: No songs yet
noSongs.body: The editor needs songs in the library. Import songs first (library → import / folder scan) and come back.

openSong.title: Open a song
openSong.body: Click a song in the list now to open it in the editor.

leftPanel.title: Toolbar
leftPanel.body: Everything for notes: add, duplicate, delete, split, merge — plus note types, voices and tap mode (coming up).

lyricsPanel.title: Lyrics panel
lyricsPanel.body: The lyric lines sit on the left. Double-click a line to jump playback right there — text and timing are editable here.

subHeaderTools.title: Editing notes
subHeaderTools.body:
Notes are the blocks on the pitch lanes: add, duplicate, delete, split (one note → two) and merge (two → one).

Edit selected notes in tempo: ⌫ deletes, ↑/↓ transposes.

noteTypes.title: Note types
noteTypes.body:
5 types for new notes:
: Normal (pitch counts)
* Golden (extra points)
F Freestyle (any note counts)
R Rap (timing only)
G Rap-gold

voices.title: Voices
voices.body: P1 = player 1, P2 = player 2 (duet!), P4/P8 = third/fourth voice. Every note belongs to a voice — that's how duet songs with separate parts are made.

tapMode.title: Tap mode — the turbo 🥁
tapMode.body: Hold the key and tap along: every click drops a note at the current playback position, lyric line by lyric line. Create notes in real time.

panels.title: Header panels
panels.body: Three panels top right: metadata (genre/language/year), audio analysis and the AI assistant.

metadataStudio.title: Metadata Studio
metadataStudio.body: The harmonize turbo: AI and rule suggestions for genre, language and year — with listen-before-assign, manual fine-editing and a review queue for uncertain matches.

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.body: All keyboard shortcuts at a glance — the editor is a keyboard instrument. Click through!

finish.title: Ready to build! 🛠️
finish.body:
You now know the editor toolbox.

Remember: Ctrl+Z saves everything, and the ? icon at the bottom right brings you back to these chapters anytime.
